summary.tagline: The Lagoni di Mercurago Nature Park, established in 1980, is a natural reserve in Piedmont, located in Mercura

days.title: Wetlands and Archaeology
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: zona umida
stops.detail: The Park includes a heterogeneous series of ecosystems: the wetland area, rich in ponds, peat bogs and marshes, represents the true beating heart of the park; in the meadows and pastures, thoroughbred horses are bred and raised, all within a lightly urbanized context rich in woods and heaths.

stops.name: insediamenti
stops.detail: Over the years, in fact, several settlements dating back to the Bronze Age and some Roman domus have been discovered.

days.title: Visitor Center and Equestrian History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: centro visite
stops.detail: The main access to the Lagoni Park is that of the headquarters and the visitor center, in via Gattico 6 in Mercurago, a hamlet of Arona.

stops.name: pascoli e i maneggi
stops.detail: Alongside this "spontaneous" type of fauna are the pastures and riding stables set up a few decades ago by Federico Tesio as horse breeding centers.
